scope: Independent standard for ds3231 on the fixed i2c task configuration, based on its copied reference driver, fixed task requirements, supplied Zephyr API pack and harness. Excludes sample_ref application cadence and device-register behavior.

api_contract.fixed_task_context: i2c1 DT device handle and 7-bit target address

signatures.i2c_write_read: int i2c_write_read(const struct device *dev, uint16_t addr, const void *write_buf, uint32_t num_write, void *read_buf, uint32_t num_read)
signatures.i2c_reg_write_byte: int i2c_reg_write_byte(const struct device *dev, uint16_t addr, uint8_t reg, uint8_t value)

headers: zephyr/kernel.h for timing calls where used
api_contract.return_semantics: Use the integer status from fallible bus/configuration calls; GPIO read yields level or error. UART poll_in is nonblocking: 0 means byte received, nonzero means no byte; poll_out returns void.

facts.requirement: Bind the required i2c handle/configuration on fixed task context: i2c1 DT device handle and 7-bit target address.

Provide the task-required operations with compatible signatures: int i2c_write_read(const struct device *dev, uint16_t addr, const void *write_buf, uint32_t num_write, void *read_buf, uint32_t num_read); int i2c_reg_write_byte(const struct device *dev, uint16_t addr, uint8_t reg, uint8_t value). Keep handle/address/configuration, buffer and return levels compatible with the reference.
Preserve the fallible API status needed to detect or propagate bus/GPIO configuration and transaction failures; do not convert an error return into success.
